steps.npc: Not much to say. Came to Weiss with other trolls when we got kicked out of caves further south, but I was just young troll then.
Mostly been enjoying living round Weiss, 'cos wildlife is interesting here.
This here is Weiss. Trolls built it years ago, after we got kicked out from caves further south. Now Weiss is our home.
It great here, now Snowflake an' her husband troll taught us goutweed farming. Food so much better now.
Eh, it kinda rough, but it getting better. Snowflake, she taught us goutweed farming. Goat, wolf, human all taste so much nicer with goutweed in.
So yeah, Weiss is good place to live, now Snowflake in charge. All trolls like Snowflake. Her husband troll kinda weird, but that not our problem.
